value.rationale: At the source engine reversal boundary, mean useful work is zero even while a bath-to-bath short circuit can persist. A universal finite-window **negative** heat-leak/work signed-count covariance is a nontrivial structural noise observable, including parameters where the instantaneous time-correlator changes sign. Its independent positive rate combination plus the measured net leak mean exactly reconstructs both microscopic forward and reverse parasitic rates, without requiring separate forward/back event-count statistics, when aggregate kinetics are known. This natural inference task goes beyond a low-value algebraic renaming or numerical example.
